scenarios.title: clean home: plugin add, setup card, desk at 100 %, Today shows "Seldon is recording"
scenarios.notes: plugin add and its confirmation, open the desk, Create logbook; desk 1910 px, setup card "2 of 3 steps to go"; after init "Seldon is recording. Nothing to do.", status ok

scenarios.title: 0.1.x plugin and logbook: omarchy plugin update, restart notice, desk with defaults, settings kept
scenarios.notes: engine update, plugin update and its confirmation, restart, open the desk; plugin 0.1.4 showed Index format mismatch after the engine, then the restart notice once; after the restart status ok, driftInBar all kept, deskWidth 100 and deskSidebar open by default, the 0.1.3 logbook opened without a question

scenarios.title: triage: Agent sorts N open changes, apply the proposal, each crisis on its own
scenarios.notes: claude-code proposed 4 (1 crisis); Enter twice on a 1910 px desk: applied 3, skipped 1 (the crisis), refused 0; the crisis linked alone by key from its row; the unevidenced change still open; steps from the skill install to the link, the changes and the evidence not counted

scenarios.title: width 50 % on a 1920 px screen: sidebar visible, all nine targets by key
scenarios.notes: desk 960 px with the sidebar open; the nine targets by 1-8 and ,; at rounding 16 the bars follow the rows' corners; the chip at 50 % reads "1", not cut

scenarios.title: three shell restarts (WP-162)
scenarios.notes: omarchy restart shell three times: service status ok each time; no Quickshell crash entry and no core dump before or after

limitations: a: plugin added with omarchy plugin add from a local file:// clone of the release's subtree split, not the published repository; the engine was already on the host, so the card's engine step and install.sh were not exercised; Create logbook needs a click and the test host has no pointer, so its command seldon init --defaults ran in a terminal; checked after the tag

b: start was plugin 0.1.4 on a 0.1.3 logbook (0.1.3 has no restart notice; the 0.1.4 deploy also put engine 0.1.4 on it); real omarchy plugin update from the local clone of the split; the engine update was a copy of the deployed binary, not install.sh; Restart shell needs a click, so its command omarchy-restart-shell ran

c: Agent sorts N open changes needs a click, so its command seldon agent ask triage ran; a fresh logbook has no agent skill, so seldon hook install skills ran first, as the engine's refusal says; the crisis was resolved by the user from its own row, not accepted from the proposal (WP-201)
d: the width was set with omarchy bar set jax.seldon deskWidth 50, since the slider and presets of Settings › Appearance need a pointer; 50 % of 1920 px is the 960 px minimum
restart: one monitor; the two-monitor restart test runs on the dev host after the tag with the release
a-d: four buttons ran as the command they run; the click → command mapping is pinned headless in tests/plugin/desk-view.sh (setup-flow, restart-updated, triage, settings)
